name: NextKeyBor
description: Supercharges the GNOME on-screen keyboard: dictation button with language selection (local whisper.cpp), word completion, hold-for-numbers and symbols, emoji and symbol search, a searchable GIF and sticker library with favourites and your own uploads. Also fixes the OSK not opening in Chromium/Electron/Qt apps and Shift latching after backspace. Needs the nextkeybord daemon.
